name: superbookmarks
description: Search and tidy your SuperBookmarks library from Claude Desktop. Talks only to the SuperBookmarks app on this computer.
long_description: Ask Claude to search your saved links, list what's unfiled, read a link's saved copy, file links on a shelf or suggest a new shelf. The SuperBookmarks app on this computer makes every change, and you can undo each one there. Needs SuperBookmarks running and a token made in its Settings (AI providers, Claude Desktop). What Claude reads from your library becomes part of your chat with Claude.

token.title: Token from SuperBookmarks
token.description: Make it in SuperBookmarks: Settings, AI providers, Claude Desktop, Make a token.

app_address.title: App address
app_address.description: Where SuperBookmarks runs on this computer.

tools.description: Links on no shelf, newest first.

tools.description: One link with its saved copy's text.

tools.description: Suggest a new shelf; the owner creates it in SuperBookmarks.
